The ectoplasm jaws of this wrench always seem to have a perfect grip on whatever you apply them to. Kinda spooky.

The Spectral wrench item is a crafted item.

This item can be obtained in the following variations. The different qualities can be an outcome of artisan recipes, the results can be improved by using items with the quality outcome attribute.

Sources

Primary Recipe Output

Craft a spectral wrench

You mesh some bone together to create a long handle and work the ectoplasm into some jaws that can be used on top of it.

Work bone and ectoplasm together to create a ghostly crafting tool.
